quick_skim.title: AI for Science with GPT-6 Astra: Thermal Design and Electrothermal Analysis of 2D CFET
quick_skim.abstract: Thermal optimization of 2D CFET inverters requires testing structural proposals against their electrical costs. We examine these research tasks using an AI agent workflow within a supplied electrothermal model. At 12 nm, Astra selects a redistributed source-interconnect geometry, while a coordinating agent proposes a substrate-directed heat-removal path. The combined design reduces peak temperature rise by 1.67 K at fixed metal volume and 20 μW. A subsequent metal-resistance sensitivity gives about 0.6-K inverter cooling alongside a 2% nFET on-current loss. Effective contact-length scaling further shows that lower temperature can accompany higher thermal resistance when current falls. Reproduction identifies agreeing implementations and retains a 104.95-K failure for diagnosis. These results show that an AI scientist workflow can propose thermal structures, test them under common constraints, and quantify their electrical cost.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 二维CFET反相器的热优化需要在结构方案与电学代价之间反复权衡。本文采用AI智能体工作流，在给定的电热模型中评估互连几何与衬底散热路径等设计。结果显示，在固定金属体积与20 μW条件下组合设计将峰值温升降低1.67 K，金属电阻灵敏度分析给出约0.6 K的冷却与2%开态电流损失。该工作表明智能体辅助工作流可高效支撑先进器件的电热协同设计。
